name: Our Lady Consolata Nkubu Catholic Parish
description: Dedicated to creating innovative solutions for modern challenges.

detail.introduction: Our Lady Consolata Nkubu is a Catholic Parish located in Nkubu, Meru Kenya which was formed in 2005      It has five five prayer houses , each with its special projects. The sites are Taita,Mikumbune, Township , Muguru And Ntharene.
detail.who_we_are: We are an organisation centered on fastening gender equity, empowering the youth and building strongand inclusive communities. At the core of our mission is the beliefs in the equal rights and opportunities of all genders. We strive to create a society with empowered persons by eliminating any discrimination. We believe that young people are the agents of change and hold immense potential to transform societies.
detail.team: We have a diverse team of enviromentalists, volunteers, and commnunity members working together to deliver exceptional results for our environmental conservation efforts.
detail.goal: Our goal is to be the best in the world
detail.mission: We are dedicated to creating amazing nature experiences using modern technologies to protect our ecosystems. Our team is passionate about building fast, clean and sustainable practices to ensure ensure biodiversity preservation
